name: release
description: Repository-native release execution and release-infrastructure remediation through gates, tags, artifacts, and publication checks.

interface.shortDescription: Cut releases or build missing release infrastructure.
interface.longDescription: Repository-native release execution and release-infrastructure remediation. Discovers the repo's versioning, changelog, gates, candidate flow, stable promotion path, install/upgrade checks, artifacts, and publication surface before cutting or repairing releases.
defaultPrompt: Use $release to cut the next patch release end to end.
Use $release to audit this repo's release readiness and point out missing components.
Use $release to build the missing release infrastructure, verify it, and resume the release.
